title: bug: providerDescriptor.contract.test.ts fails 4/23 since be889d73 (WT-05) moved the codex config writer out of the test's anchored codex branches
description:
Repro: in a git-archive snapshot of be889d73, run `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm ci && npx vitest run src/providers/providerDescriptor.contract.test.ts`. Result: 4 failed | 19 passed. The anchored site is 122 lines where the test expects >200, and 22 shared, 43 emitter and 17 side-specific literals read "absent". The full daemon suite fails only this file (4 failed | 6250 passed | 20 skipped). With scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1} taken from be889d73^ the file passes 23/23.
Cause: WT-05 moved the codex config writer into write_codex_config() (moe-agent.sh:973) and Write-MoeCodexConfig (moe-agent.ps1:997). Both now sit outside BRANCH_ANCHORS (providerDescriptor.contract.test.ts:60-68), and the anchored codex site shrank from 372 to 200 lines (sh) and from 374 to 228 lines (ps1). Fix: anchor those writers and re-point codexDescriptor's emitter evidence at the worktree-aware literals. Never weaken an assertion. CI's daemon test:coverage gate is red until this lands. Found by CQ-R13 (task-f4811a72) step-4 verification.
definitionOfDone: `npx vitest run src/providers/providerDescriptor.contract.test.ts` in packages/moe-daemon passes 23/23 at the fix commit, with no assertion removed or loosened (the >200-line site floor and every fact check stay)
The full daemon `npm test`, run in a snapshot outside the live checkout, passes with 0 failed
reopenReason: Governor promote: HIGH regression from WT-05 (be889d73) — providerDescriptor.contract.test.ts 4/23 red, CI daemon gate red. Daemon test-only fix, off the wrapper lane; dependsOn 7db14e2d (lane head editing the codex branches the test anchors).
